senses.gloss: ? utpharati (cf. Skt. utphalati, recorded in this sense, pw), jumps up: Mv 〔ii.249.16〕 (prose) (tato vānaro tasya śuśumārasya) grīvāto utphāritvā (so, or uṣphār˚, mss.; Senart upphār˚; but not causative; prob. read utpharitvā, or upphar˚?) taṃ udumbaraṃ prakrānto.

utphikā, Mvy 〔9542〕 (so Mironov), or utpika (m. or nt.?), 〔9541〕 (and v.l. Mironov), n. of a disease; Tib. either glo baḥi (of the lungs), or mgoḥi (of the head), glog pa (on which see rajata; ulcer? cancer?). Chin. apparently a disease characterized by insanity. See also uvyadha.
